*F-asyncMPC* (Asynchronous MPC) is part of *Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti, Lindell, Ostrovsky, and Sahai. [*Universally composable two-party and multi-party secure computation*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2002/140). In 34th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 494–503, 2002.
- Ben-Or, Canetti, and Goldreich. [*Asynchronous secure computation*](https://doi.org/10.1145/167088.167109). In 25th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 52–61, 1993.
- Ben-Or, Kelmer, and Rabin. [*Asynchronous secure computations with optimal resilience*](https://doi.org/10.1145/197917.198088). In 13th ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC), pages 183–192, 1994.
